Expected result: Call recording is greyed out for them AND they still have the company value

Steps: Company Rules > Policies > turn 'transcribe voicemail' OFF > Save. Set up a NEW person
Expected result: That person's voicemail-to-text is OFF

Steps: Company Rules > Holidays > choose a country and year > Add > Save
Expected result: The public holidays for that country and year appear with correct dates

Steps: Open any call queue > Business Hours > Custom Days > 'Add company holidays'
Expected result: The company dates are added to that queue with an action on each
Known limits / notes: If the queue has no closed-hours action set, it refuses and tells you to set one. That is correct behaviour

Steps: Company Rules > Holidays > 'Choose lines' > tick some queues and people > Apply
Expected result: A result appears for each line: added, already had them, or skipped with a reason
Known limits / notes: A line holds 10 holidays. A full US year is 11, so one will not fit and it tells you which

Steps: Company Rules > Policies > Call recording > type: This call may be recorded for quality purposes
Expected result: It turns red and will NOT let you save
Known limits / notes: That exact phrase is meant to fail. It says recording happens but not that a third party may do it. Then try: This call may be recorded or transcribed by us, or by a third party acting on our behalf - that should save

Steps: Company Rules > Policies > turn OFF 'people can play their own calls' > Save. Go to Reports > Call logs as a normal user
Expected result: The play button is gone on their own recordings
Known limits / notes: NEW TODAY. Check all of: Call recording, Call history, Inbound, Outbound, Voicemail, and Performance > Callbacks

Steps: Turn OFF 'admins can play anyone's calls' > Save. As an admin, open Reports > Call logs
Expected result: An admin sees the play button on their OWN calls but not on other people's
Known limits / notes: A call answered out of a queue has no clear owner - the play button stays visible for those. That is deliberate
